scenarios.title: 1. Verify initial review findings panel title text
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that before the patch, the review findings panel heading displays the exact text 'Review findings', indicating pre-change UI state.

scenarios.title: 2. Verify review findings panel subtitle text when no result
scenarios.purpose: Check that the subtitle under the review findings heading shows the exact pre-change instructional text when no review results exist.

steps.expected: Issues are grounded in changed lines and repository context.

scenarios.title: 4. Verify presence and text of clear diff button disabled state
scenarios.purpose: Validate that the 'Clear diff' button is present and disabled when no diff content is loaded, matching pre-change behavior.

scenarios.title: 5. Verify that 'Analyze change' button is disabled initially and shows correct label
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the analyze button is disabled initially due to missing API readiness and diff, and the label is exactly 'Analyze change' with the keyboard shortcut shown as '⌘ ↵'.
